input.parameter_vector: ordered GenericParameterId, kind, default-or-null and declared constraints
input.environment: finite visible TypeId, TraitId, EffectId, ErrorId and evidence registry

normalization: expand transparent aliases before kind or relation comparison
allocate fresh inference variables per candidate and never share them with sibling candidates
canonicalize StaticInt as exact mathematical integer, EffectRow and ErrorSet as duplicate-free identity-sorted sets
normalize every type and conformance argument before occurs, equality, subtype or evidence checks
ordered_steps: reject too many explicit generic arguments
bind each explicit argument to the same-position parameter and require exact kind agreement
collect equations and lower-bound constraints only from explicit value-argument descriptors
perform kind checks and the occurs check before solving
require one unique complete substitution; defaults fill only variables unconstrained after explicit argument solving
evaluate where predicates in source order for diagnostics but as a normalized set for semantic identity
seal GenericSubstitutionId and GenericApplicabilityProofId only after every constraint succeeds

where_predicates.type_equality: both normalized TypeIds are exactly equal
where_predicates.trait_conformance: one static ConformanceId and TraitWitnessId is selected without runtime or provider lookup
where_predicates.effect_row_relation: the normalized left EffectRow is a subset of the normalized right EffectRow
where_predicates.visibility: a public signature cannot expose a type, effect or error identity outside its visibility domain

forbidden_solver_inputs: source, declaration, import or provider order
generic_applicability.failure_atomicity: a failed candidate emits no substitution, binding, loan, capture, witness or HIR residue

generic_variance.admission: a declared out parameter occurs only covariantly, a declared in parameter only contravariantly, and an unmarked parameter is invariant after alias expansion
generic_variance.constructor_subtyping: same GenericConstructorId and arity are required; every argument relation must satisfy its descriptor and all ownership, mutation, cleanup and region gates

identity_axes: ordered channel kinds and external labels
fixed, repeated and NamedPack rest shape
parameter mode and type ownership qualifier
authority, call-right, capture and cleanup profile

compatibility.parameter_type: contravariant under the admitted static subtype relation
compatibility.result_type: covariant under the admitted static subtype relation

forwarding.callback_errors: an invocation owner either handles every callback ErrorId or includes it in its declared ErrorSet
forwarding.callback_effects: an invocation owner either discharges every callback EffectId through an admitted handler or includes it in its declared EffectRow
forwarding.row_variables: must be bound by the complete generic substitution before HIR sealing
forwarding.private_identity_leak: rejected before API digest or HIR sealing

no_hidden_adaptation: no sync/async or ordinary/message mode conversion
